text: {"lessons":["Selling at a gain feels satisfying, but my sale prices alone do not show whether selling improved my returns; I should weigh each trade against my plan and alternatives.","Repeatedly trimming Stock A, D, and E as they rose reduced my exposure, so I should check that sales leave a suitably diversified portfolio rather than reacting only to gains.","Because past price changes do not predict future ones, I should avoid assuming these stocks will keep rising or fall after I sell, and make decisions based on current risk and allocation."]}
